title: Escape Simulator 2
summary: Adds HDR output by replacing the ACES tone map in the HDRP grading LUT, with configurable tone mapping and color grading.
notes: Tone mapper, peak brightness, and color grading changes are baked into the grading LUT; in rooms that cache the LUT they apply the next time a room loads. Game brightness, UI brightness, and gamma correction apply immediately.
